## Key concepts

- Two-audience split: docs/internal/, docs/user/, docs/shared/
- Phases 0–9 map to software lifecycle from charter to retirement
- ADRs document decisions with alternatives and consequences
- Runbooks by symptom (not component)
- Drift-prevention DoD checklist in governance chapter
- Maturity model: Chaos → Scaffold → Discipline → Platform

## Core rules (AGENTS.md)

- Do not invent APIs or endpoints
- Do not leak internal-only content into docs/user/
- Update docs with behaviour changes — same PR
- Refer to shared glossary for term definitions
- When in doubt, ask — do not guess
